stem:
\(\frac{12x + 28}{4} - \frac{s}{13} = r(x - 8)\)
In the given equation, s and r are constants, and s > 0. If the equation has infinitely many solutions, what is the value of s?
solution_steps: Simplify the left side: (12x + 28)/4 = 3x + 7, so the equation becomes 3x + 7 − s/13 = r(x − 8)
Expand the right side: 3x + 7 − s/13 = rx − 8r
For infinitely many solutions, coefficients of x must match: r = 3
why_this_difficulty: Hard: requires simplifying a compound fraction, then applying two simultaneous conditions for infinitely many solutions — coefficient match and constant match.

stem:
A car wash charges $4 per vehicle, plus a flat $10 daily equipment fee. Which equation represents the total amount earned, d, on a day when n vehicles are washed?
A. d = 4n
B. d = 10n + 4
C. d = 4n + 10
D. d = 4(n + 10)

distractor_rationales.A: Omits the flat $10 equipment fee entirely
distractor_rationales.B: Swaps the roles of 4 and 10 — treats $10 as the per-vehicle rate and $4 as the flat fee
distractor_rationales.D: Incorrectly distributes 4 over (n + 10), implying the $10 fee also scales with the per-vehicle rate

solution_steps: Identify the two components: $4 per vehicle → 4n, and $10 flat fee → +10
why_this_difficulty: Easy: one-step translation; two components (per-unit rate + flat fee) map directly to mx + b form.
sat_key_phrases: which equation represents
represents this situation
total amount

stem:
A group of friends splits a $12 delivery fee equally, and each person also pays $8 for their own meal. Which equation represents the total amount t each person pays if there are p people in the group?
A. t = 8p + 12
B. t = 8 + 12p
C. t = 8 + 12/p
D. t = (8 + 12)/p

distractor_rationales.A: Treats both costs as per-person rates — applies p to the delivery fee instead of dividing by it
distractor_rationales.B: Treats the $12 delivery fee as a per-person charge rather than a shared cost
distractor_rationales.D: Divides the entire sum by p, incorrectly splitting the individual $8 meal cost as well

solution_steps: Each person's share of the delivery fee: 12/p
Each person's meal cost: 8 (fixed per person)
why_this_difficulty: Easy: two components but one involves division; student must recognise which cost is shared vs individual.
sat_key_phrases: which equation represents
total amount each person pays

stem:

A. T = 15s + 6d
B. T = 21(s + d)
C. T = 6s + 15d
D. T = 15s − 6d

distractor_rationales.B: Adds both rates (15 + 6 = 21) and applies to total hours — wrong structure; rates only apply to their own hours
distractor_rationales.C: Swaps the rates: applies 6 to standard hours and 15 to deluxe hours
distractor_rationales.D: Subtracts instead of adding the two production totals

why_this_difficulty: Medium: two independent rates applied to two separate time variables; student must resist combining rates incorrectly.
sat_key_phrases: which equation represents

stem:

A. c = 65h
B. c = 40h + 65
C. c = 65 + 40(h − 1)

distractor_rationales.A: Applies the $65 first-hour rate to every hour — ignores the different rate for additional hours
distractor_rationales.B: Applies $40 to all h hours and adds $65 as a flat fee — wrong structure for a tiered rate
distractor_rationales.D: Swaps the two rates: applies $65 as the additional-hour rate and $40 as the first-hour charge

stem:
A bookstore sells notebooks for $4 each. A customer also pays a one-time membership fee of $10. The equation 4n + 10 = 34 represents the total amount in dollars the customer spends, where n is the number of notebooks purchased. What is the value of n, and what does it represent?
A. n = 6; the total cost in dollars
B. n = 6; the number of notebooks the customer purchased
C. n = 34; the total amount spent in dollars
D. n = 10; the membership fee in dollars

distractor_rationales.A: Correctly solves n = 6 but misidentifies what n represents — n is the number of notebooks, not a dollar amount
distractor_rationales.C: Reports the total cost (34) as the value of n rather than solving the equation
distractor_rationales.D: Reports the membership fee coefficient (10) as n instead of solving

solution_steps: n is defined as the number of notebooks, so n = 6 means 6 notebooks were purchased
why_this_difficulty: Easy: one-step solve followed by identifying the contextual meaning of the variable from the problem statement.
sat_key_phrases: the equation represents
where n is
what is the value of n
what does it represent

stem:
A shipping company charges $7 per package plus a flat handling fee of $15 per order. The equation 7p + 15 = 71 represents an order's total cost in dollars, where p is the number of packages. What does the solution to this equation represent in this context?
A. The total number of dollars charged per package
B. The number of packages in the order
C. The handling fee per package
D. The total number of orders placed

distractor_rationales.A: Describes the coefficient 7 (rate per package), not the solution p
distractor_rationales.C: Describes the constant 15 divided by something — the handling fee is a flat fee per order, not per package
distractor_rationales.D: p is defined as packages per order, not the number of orders

solution_steps: p is the number of packages, so the solution p = 8 means the order contained 8 packages
why_this_difficulty: Medium: student must solve and then correctly map the solution back to the contextual quantity it represents, resisting distractors that reference other quantities in the equation.
sat_key_phrases: the equation represents
where p is
what does the solution represent
in this context

stem:
A contractor charges $85 per hour for labor and $120 for materials. The equation 85h + 120 = 715 represents the total charge in dollars for a job, where h is the number of hours worked. What does the solution to this equation represent?
A. The hourly labor rate charged by the contractor
B. The number of hours the contractor worked on the job
C. The total cost of materials for the job
D. The total charge in dollars for the entire job

distractor_rationales.A: Describes the coefficient 85, which is the rate — not the solution h
distractor_rationales.C: Describes the constant 120 — the material cost is given, not solved for
distractor_rationales.D: 715 is the total charge (the right-hand side of the equation), not the solution h

solution_steps: h is the number of hours worked, so the solution h = 7 represents 7 hours of labor
why_this_difficulty: Hard: all four choices describe genuine quantities in the problem; student must distinguish the solution (h = hours) from the coefficient (rate), the constant (materials), and the right-hand side (total).
sat_key_phrases: the equation represents
where h is
what does the solution represent
